answer.reason: Beyond the measurements, the marked verses tell of the LORD's glory filling the house and of waters flowing out from it.

clauses.english: was filled with the glory of the LORD, which came in by the east gate
clauses.quote: the glory of the LORD filled the house

clauses.english: had waters flowing out from under its threshold eastward
clauses.quote: waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward
